messages:
ellie: Heads-up — prototype for a 'budgeted-headroom' autoscaler for Dedicated GPU pools.
ellie: Idea: instead of fixed headroom, compute per-tenant headroom budget based on recent burstiness, SLA tier, and refundable burst credits.
ellie: Benefits: reduces wasted idle GPUs while keeping tail latency SLOs for high-tier tenants.
sam: short q — how do you estimate burstiness? rolling window? percentiles?
ellie: rolling percentile + EWMA of burst frequency. baseline = recent 95th qps; burst_multiplier = clamp(1, 3, spike_rate_norm * 2).
kevin: how do we avoid mutual eviction storms when many tenants spike? global cap + token bucket?
ravi: i'd do two-level: per-tenant soft budget + global shared reservoir. reservoir handles very transient spikes, per-tenant covers sustained bursts.
sam: operator/runtime boundary: who owns refill policy? controller or runtime?
ellie: proposal: controller computes budgets and annotates pool/tenant objects; runtime enforces admission and issues refill feedback (used/remaining). keeps fast path in runtime.
kevin: what about fairness vs cost? need clear prioritization: SLA tier -> token weight, then recent usage penalty. also emergency_reserve for critical tenants.
ravi: agree. also consider decaying credits so greedy tenants don't hoard. implement refundable credits for unused reserved headroom.
ellie: rollout plan: canary with 1-2 non-critical pools, enable sim harness and replay production traces. expose metrics: budget_alloc, budget_used, reservoir_drain, eviction_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency.
kevin: add admission reasons label: reason=(reservoir|tenant_budget|preemptible_fallback) so we can slice traces.
sam: observability: add heatmaps for tenant burst frequency and budget utilization. alerts for reservoir depletion and eviction spikes.
ellie: safety knobs: min_headroom_floor, per-tenant_max_burst, global_max_reservoir_drain_rate, manual emergency_reserve toggle.
prewarm-bot: deploy started: canary-autoscaler/budgeted-headroom-v1 -> roll 1/3 :rocket:
sam: nice. i'll draft the API proto for budget annotations + runtime feedback and a sim scenario to test oscillation cases.
ellie: thanks — i'll open an RFC PR with the proto + sim results by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
